image_description: An interior view of a rustic sawmill or lumber processing facility. The scene features heavy industrial machinery, specifically a large green bandsaw mechanism with levers and gears. A worker in dark clothing is visible on the left operating or standing near the machine. In the foreground right, a rough-hewn wooden post dominates the frame. The floor consists of worn wooden planks. Through the open structure in the background, daylight and stacked lumber are faintly visible.

The worker's interaction with the machine is vague. The hands appear to merge with the machine controls or clothing, lacking clear finger definition or distinct mechanical interaction points.
The connecting rods and levers of the green machine have ambiguous pivot points. Some bars seem to float or connect to empty space rather than a logical mechanical joint.
